correctness.rationale: Closed form follows from recurrence roots a,-1. For odd p|a+1, the difference within equal-parity indices factors as a^{2j}(a^{2(i-j)}-1)/(a+1), times a in the odd case. LTE yields v_p(a^{2d}-1)=v_p(a+1)+v_p(d) because p∤a-1; hence v_p(J_{2i}-J_{2j})=v_p(J_{2i+1}-J_{2j+1})=v_p(i-j). By CRT each parity among the first m supported odd modulus terms permutes Z/m. Even m>=4 excludes residue 2 (only J0 even). For p|a not dividing a+1, all Jn for n>=1 reduce to ±1, allowing only standalone p=3; if p∤a(a+1), period p-1 limits image to at most p-1 values. Independent exact full-state recurrence enumeration checked every even base a=2..50 and m=1..120 (3000 complete-image decisions), all matched; this finite check supplements the complete infinite proof.
